# Provenance — vendored OathParser files

These files are copied verbatim from the upstream project. They are reference
material for Phase 1 (card data). They are **not** part of the TypeScript build
(`tsconfig.json` `include` is `["src"]`) and must not be imported from `src/`
until a later unit decides how they are consumed.

- **Repo:** https://github.com/Vagabottos/OathParser
- **Commit:** `53b7f533b8fb7fbd617d6bde6fe824238680262f`
- **Commit date:** 2022-01-24
- **Vendored on:** 2026-09-08
- **License:** MIT (see `LICENSE`)
